item.text: {"explanation":"Maintains sequence, retained records, reader acknowledgments, and the latest visible value per key. Sets append records and update the view. Acknowledgments advance only within the permitted interval. Compaction computes the minimum acknowledgment, preserves all newer records, and preserves the latest record at or below the watermark for every key, maintaining sequence order.","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state;if(s===null){s={seq:0,log:[],ack:{},view:{}};for(var i=0;i<config.readers.length;i++)s.ack[config.readers[i]]=0}if(event.type==='set'){s.seq++;s.log.push({seq:s.seq,key:event.key,value:event.value});s.view[event.key]=event.value}else if(event.type==='ack'){var old=s.ack[event.reader];if(old<=event.seq&&event.seq<=s.seq)s.ack[event.reader]=event.seq}else if(event.type==='compact'){var w=Infinity,last={},keep=[];for(var i=0;i<config.readers.length;i++){var a=s.ack[config.readers[i]];if(a<w)w=a}for(var i=0;i<s.log.length;i++){var x=s.log[i];if(x.seq<=w)last[x.key]=x}for(var i=0;i<s.log.length;i++){var x=s.log[i];if(x.seq>w||last[x.key]===x)keep.push(x)}s.log=keep}var log=[];for(var i=0;i<s.log.length;i++)log.push(s.log[i].seq);return{state:s,output:{log:log,view:Object.assign({},s.view)}}}"}
